data.name: Haripreet
data.gender_notes: Haripreet is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Haripreet is a Sanskrit name that combines 'Hari' (God) and 'Preet' (joy or love). This name symbolizes the joy and love one experiences in the presence of God. The name Haripreet carries the meaning “God's joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Haripreet usually hope their child will grow to embody god's joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes the presence of God and brings joy and love.
data.etymology: Haripreet belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haripreet total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
